description: Proof of Reserves: the named on-chain wallets that hold the vault's real-world assets, the certified issuer behind each asset (Backed/xStocks, Ondo, oro), live on-chain balances and USD values, plus the daily decision receipts and lifetime value paid to holders. Each asset also carries what its issuer can do to it (issuerControls, issuerControlsText): whether it can move or burn the token from any account, freeze accounts, pause transfers or run a program on every transfer, read live from the asset's own mint. Those are the issuers' rules, not VaultBags'; an unread mint is reported as unread, never as having no controls. Every wallet and balance is public and verifiable on Solscan. Read-only.
name: get_proof_of_reserves
